name: Isolated Red-team Runner
mechanism: Executes red-team tools, configs, plugins, graders and datasets inside a disposable environment with scoped credentials, bounded filesystem access and controlled egress.
use_when: Evaluations load remote datasets templates or executable plugins
CI runs adversarial model outputs or untrusted pull requests
avoid_when: The runner has no isolation and shares production secrets
The test target can perform irreversible production effects
expected_effects: Reproducible separation between testing and production authority
failure_modes: A malicious config executes with runner privileges
